Design requirement: DR01: Toggling rst resets the MARB: no CIF ack, no m_rd/m_wr, crc_valid=0, registers back to 0
Coverage: cg_reset (reset while idle / reset during an active transfer)
Verification Criteria: Reset checker: outputs inactive while rst=1; read_ctrl_reg/read_dprio_reg return 0 after reset
Comment: Reset is asynchronous (posedge rst in RTL)

Design requirement: DR02: All outputs change only on the rising edge of clk
Verification Criteria: All checkers sample at RisingEdge+ReadOnly; waveform inspection
Comment: Implicitly exercised by every pin-level checker

Design requirement: DR03: The DUT has 3 CIFs, 1 MIF and 1 APB interface
Verification Criteria: Testbench integration: one agent per interface; each CIF has transactions seen by the scoreboard

Design requirement: DR04: Client priority is configurable through the APB registers (CTRL 0x00, DPRIO 0x04)
Coverage: cg_registers: cp_enable, cp_mode, cp_prio0, cp_prio1, cp_prio2; APB cg_trans_kind
Verification Criteria: Register read-back test (read value == reg_model); timing checker uses the configured priorities

Design requirement: DR05: Priorities can be changed dynamically during operation
Verification Criteria: Timing checker always compares against the latest reg_model values

Design requirement: DR06: The MARB must be disabled (enable=0) before DPRIO is changed
Verification Criteria: Sequence rule in virtual sequencer; checker: no m_rd/m_wr issued while enable=0
Comment: Writing DPRIO while enabled is illegal stimulus

Design requirement: DR07: The internal sort (6 clk cycles) must finish before re-enabling after a DPRIO change
Coverage: cg_dprio_delay (cycles between DPRIO write and enable)
Verification Criteria: Virtual sequence waits cfg.dprio_reg_write_delay; timing checker ignores arbitration for 6 cycles after a change
Comment: Also applies when switching mode static->dynamic

Design requirement: DR08: Only one CIF is acknowledged per clock cycle
Verification Criteria: Timing checker: at most one of c0_ack/c1_ack/c2_ack high per cycle (onehot0)

Design requirement: DR09a: Static mode - fixed order CIF1 > CIF2 > CIF3
Verification Criteria: Timing checker: the served CIF is the lowest-index pending CIF
Comment: Requires simultaneous requests to be meaningful

Design requirement: DR09b: Dynamic mode - the pending CIF with the highest DPRIO value is served
Coverage: cg_arbitration: winner x pending-set, mode=DYNAMIC; cg_registers
Verification Criteria: Timing checker: served CIF has the max priority among pending CIFs (from reg_model)

Design requirement: DR09c: Equal priorities fall back to the default order CIF1 > CIF2 > CIF3
Coverage: cg_arbitration: tie bins (2-way and 3-way equal priorities)
Verification Criteria: Timing checker: on equal priority the lowest index wins
Comment: Corner case; default DPRIO value is 0 = all equal

Design requirement: DR10: The MIF ack closes the handshake and is routed to the served CIF in the same cycle
Verification Criteria: Timing checker: cN_ack == m_ack for the selected CIF; all other cN_ack = 0

Design requirement: DR11a: CIF requests (rd/wr, addr, wr_data) are forwarded unchanged to the MIF
Coverage: cg_fulltrans: access x addr x data cross
Verification Criteria: Scoreboard: reference model item == MIF-CRC connector item

Design requirement: DR11b: Read data from the MIF is returned unchanged to the served CIF
Verification Criteria: Scoreboard compares rd data seen on CIF and MIF

Design requirement: DR13: crc_valid is asserted in the MIF acknowledge cycle (and only then)
Verification Criteria: Timing checker: crc_valid == m_ack every cycle

Design requirement: DR14: CRC8 (poly 0x07) is calculated over {addr, data}; data = wr_data on write and rd_data on read
Verification Criteria: Reference model computes CRC8; scoreboard compares with the CRC from the sSDT monitor

Design requirement: MIF is not accessed while the MARB is disabled (enable=0)
Verification Criteria: Timing checker: no m_rd/m_wr while enable=0
Comment: Implied by the control register description

Design requirement: SDT P1: rd and wr are never asserted at the same time
Verification Criteria: SDT interface checker (sdt_if_assertions) on CIF0-2 and MIF

Design requirement: SDT P2: addr is not X when rd or wr is asserted
Verification Criteria: SDT interface checker on CIF0-2 and MIF

Design requirement: SDT P3: wr_data is not X when wr is asserted
Verification Criteria: SDT interface checker on CIF0-2 and MIF

Design requirement: SDT: a request (rd/wr, addr, wr_data) stays stable until ack
Verification Criteria: SDT interface checker (stability check)
Comment: Implied by Fig 3.1, not listed as an invariant

Design requirement: sSDT PR1: valid is never high while rst is high
Verification Criteria: sSDT interface checker (if_ssdt_assert_check, provided)

Design requirement: sSDT PR2: data has a valid (non-X) value when valid is high
Verification Criteria: sSDT interface checker (provided)

Design requirement: sSDT PR3: data is 0 when valid is low
Verification Criteria: sSDT interface checker (provided)

Design requirement: APB: protocol rules (sel/strb stable, rdata/slverr not X, ...)
Verification Criteria: APB interface checker (if_apb_assert_check, provided and already integrated)
Comment: Provided VIP; only used for configuration
